correctness.rationale: arXiv:2610.01112v1 proves \(\operatorname{tr}(V^{-1})=2N/\nu\) for uniform \(N\)-mode Gaussian steady states and gives the \(N\)-mode entropy-production identity. Its displacement-QFI formula applies for arbitrary \(N\). With \(x_i=\nu\lambda_i(V^{-1})\), \(\sum_i x_i=2N\) and \(\max_i x_i=R\); Jensen gives \(\sum_{i>1}x_i^{-1}\ge(2N-1)^2/(2N-R)\). Substitution proves the bound analytically. The packaged checker verifies only algebra and finite sample instances, not the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The source explicitly identifies multimode scaling as a future direction. The theorem gives a closed system-size law valid for all uniform multimode Gaussian steady states, including correlated ones: \(R<2N\), a quantitative EPR blow-up near that ceiling, and an extensive lower bound when \(R\) scales linearly with \(N\). These are structural consequences relevant to scalable continuous-variable sensing, not a routine finite-size recomputation.
